goal.decided: Our accounting colleagues print each invoice themselves, at that client's tax rate, without asking a developer. Once it holds, a colleague from accounting saves an invoice's lines from their spreadsheet, runs one command with the client's tax rate, and gets the printed invoice, following the README alone and writing no Python.

deliverables.name: A colleague from accounting turns the lines saved from their spreadsheet into a printed invoice at their client's tax rate with one command
A developer sets the command up once on an accounting machine, and from then on a colleague from accounting prints each invoice from the README alone, with no developer to ask
